HISTORICAL PROVENANCE — SUPERSEDED

This document records an earlier migration decision and is retained only for provenance. It is NOT an active identity or routing authority.

Superseded by: IRIS Name Reconciliation 003, 2026-09-23.
Current result: the former local IRIS.FORGE identity is closed; the temporary IRIS.FOUNDRY replacement is also removed. Applicable deterministic technical work delegates to global EDEN FORGE. No replacement local worker exists.

--- ORIGINAL HISTORICAL RECORD ---

EDEN ATOMIC NAME MIGRATION 002 — IRIS

STATUS: EXECUTED

OLD ACTIVE NAME
IRIS.FORGE

NEW CANONICAL NAME
IRIS.FOUNDRY

FUNCTIONAL MEANING
FOUNDRY — Final Output Unification, Normalization, Derivation, Rendering & Yield

CONCEPTUAL MEANING
A foundry turns prepared material into a finished formed output. Within IRIS, FOUNDRY is the local visual-production/assembly stage that turns prepared visual instructions and components into renderable output. It does not take over independent EDEN FORGE.

MIGRATION SCOPE
Identity/name only. Existing IRIS.FORGE behavior, inputs, outputs and routing semantics were preserved. Internal prompts, modules, workflows and documentation were updated. Independent EDEN FORGE remains unchanged.
